source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-16

procedures.title: Window regulator, power: remove, disassemble and install
steps: Disassembly: Lock the spring-loaded arm before taking the motor off (see figure 38 in the manual).
Clamp the regulator assembly in a vise.
Power the motor with jumper leads from a 12 volt DC source until the semi-circular hole in the sector gear lines up over one of the 2 weld nuts on the mounting plate.
Thread a 1/4"-20 x 1" bolt into that weld nut so its end goes through the sector gear hole; if needed, open the gear hole slightly with a file or drill.
Fit a nut on the bolt to hold the arm locked.
Installation: If the regulator was disassembled, make sure the lock bolt has been taken out.
Install the lubricated regulator and guide rails in reverse order of removal.
Confirm the connectors are firmly on the motor, then test the window thoroughly.
Refit the door trim panel and control handles.

procedures.title: Door lock and remote controls: remove and install
steps: Removal: Run the window fully up.
Take off the door trim panel.
Remove the cover from the upper rear access hole.
Free the upper control rod: first remove the plastic guide clip, then release the carburetor-type clips at each end and pull the rod out through the access hole.
Free the lock control rods by releasing the clips at each end and lifting the rods outward.
Remove the remote control assembly (4 screws into the inner door panel).
Remove the crank link (intermediate pivot) (2 screws into the inner panel).
Remove the door lock (3 screws) and lift it out through the access hole.
notes: Parts identification: figure 27 in the manual.
Figure 28 in the manual shows the door weatherstrip: weatherstrip, screws, spacer, striker and lock pillar.
